f1.quote: 700 K annealing should enhance the magnetization and maximum conventional isothermal magnetic entropy change of 1 µm-spaced nanoribbons without bulk crystallization

f2.quote: Strain was restricted to the elastic regime up to 2%

f3.quote: ribbons were 500 µm long, 300 nm wide, and 35 nm thick with 1 or 2 µm spacing

f4.quote: SQUID measurements were performed from 2–300 K under 1 kOe in ZFC/FC modes and with fields parallel or perpendicular to the ribbon axis

f5.quote: Magnetocaloric isotherms covered 5–200 K in fields up to 50 kOe, with entropy change calculated by the Maxwell relation

f6.quote: At 700 K the amorphous matrix and cubic-type short-range order remained intact without detectable recrystallization, phase decomposition, grain growth, or appreciable roughness change, but short-range atomic reordering and structural relaxation occurred and fabrication-induced internal strain was re

f7.quote: Annealing-induced short-range reordering and strain relaxation reduce local domain-pinning barriers, improve collective exchange and ferromagnetic alignment, and increase the effective ferromagnetic volume fraction

f8.quote: 2 µm separation magnetically decoupled the ribbons

f9.quote: Relative to the as-deposited, unannealed state, 700 K annealing should enhance the magnetization and maximum conventional isothermal magnetic entropy change of 1 µm-spaced nanoribbons without bulk crystallization

f10.quote: 700 K annealing should enhance the magnetization

f11.quote: maximum −ΔSM ≈ 1.25 J kg−1 K−1 at 140 K and ΔH = 50 kOe
